posts.author: vineetreynolds
posts.text: There was a run up in the share price since June/July last year. A subsequent split didnt change the volumes. One reason for the run up could have been the reported figures for free float of the company - some of the documents published to the exchanges gave the impression to the lay investor that the market cap was low (around 75cr for a company with 1k cr revenue), when it was just the free float market cap. It’s better to arrive at the valuation of the company based on revenue and earnings. Should you adopt a the valuation based approach, you might see why the rights issue was priced at aro…
